_what: World-space dry/green patches on the FieldGrass meadow bands (hero round 20, 2026-10-03; both Gemini critiques). Built by scripts/make_grass_dryness.py: duplicates the KiteDemo FieldGrass base material and its three LOD instances into target_dir (no vendor edit), multiplies the copy's BaseColor input by lerp(1, dry_tint, dryness), dryness = strength * saturate((noise - lo) / (hi - lo)), noise = Gradient-ALU Noise of AbsoluteWorldPosition / noise_scale_m, 0..1. Round 19 showed the vendor GrassDeadColor mask is per-blade only (LESSONS 2026-10-03o).
_tint_note: A MULTIPLIER on the vendor colour, not a colour. Gemini's dry (0.42, 0.38, 0.28) over green (0.22, 0.31, 0.15) is (1.9, 1.2, 1.9); blue lowered to 1.2 so dry reads straw, not grey.
_tuning: 2026-10-03 r20c: 60 m / [0.45,0.70] / (1.7,1.25,1.2) and 150 m / [0.55,0.75] read as an even yellow shift at the hero camera; a red hard-threshold control (hero_r20_ctrl) showed the camera sits inside one 150 m patch. 45 m puts several patches in view.
